standard-dialogue.npc: Well hello there traveller. If you're looking for a cocktail the barman will happily make you one.

Or if you're looking for some training in cocktail making, then I'm your gnome! Aluft Gianne jnr. is looking for gnome cooks, barmen and barwomen to help in his new venture, so it's a useful skill to have. I'm
sure the human [boys/girls] will like it as well.

options.text: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.

steps.player: No thanks, I prefer to stay this side of the bar.

options.text: Ok then I'll give it a go.

steps.player: Ok then I'll give it a go.

steps.npc: Excellent. It's not an easy job, I'll have to try you out first. I'm sure you'll be great though.
Here, take this cocktail guide. The book tells you how to make all the cocktails we serve. I'll tell you what I need and you can make them.
Take a look at the book then come and talk to me.

standard-dialogue-speaking-a-2nd-time.npc: Hi, are you ready to make your first cocktail?
Ok then, to start with make a Fruit Blast. Here, you'll need these ingredients, but I'm afraid I can't give you any more if you mess up.

standard-dialogue-speaking-a-2nd-time.text: Blurberry gives you two lemons, one orange, one pineapple, a cocktail shaker, a glass and a knife.

standard-dialogue-fruit-blast-task-dialo.text: If the player has a premade fr' blast and no fruit blast in their inventory:

steps.npc: No, I need you to make the Fruit Blast yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.

standard-dialogue-fruit-blast-task-dialo.text: If the player no longer has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:

options.text: I'm afraid I lost the cocktail shaker you gave to me.

steps.npc: I can see how that would make it hard to mix cocktails. I'll give you another one, but please try not lose any more.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.

standard-dialogue-fruit-blast-task-dialo.text: If the player has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:

steps.npc: I don't know what you have there but it's no Fruit Blast!

standard-dialogue-fruit-blast-task-dialo.text: If the player has a fruit blast in their inventory:

steps.text: You give Blurberry the Fruit Blast. He takes a sip...

steps.npc: Hmmm... not bad, not bad at all.
Now can you make me a Pineapple Punch? I can give you what you need, but again I won't be able to give you any more if you make a mistake.

steps.text: Blurberry gives you three pineapples, a pair of oranges, a lemon and a lime.

steps.npc: Let me know when it's done.

standard-dialogue-pineapple-punch-task-d.npc: How are you faring with the Pineapple Punch?

standard-dialogue-pineapple-punch-task-d.text: If the player has a premade p' punch and no pineapple punch in their inventory:

steps.npc: No, I need you to make the Pineapple Punch yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.

standard-dialogue-pineapple-punch-task-d.text: If the player no longer has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:
If the player has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:
If the player has a pineapple punch in their inventory:

steps.text: You give Blurberry the Pineapple Punch. He takes a sip...

steps.npc: Not bad, not bad at all.... I can certainly sell drinks of that quality.
Okay then let's try something with some real booze in it! Make me a Wizard Blizzard.

steps.text: Blurberry gives you some vodka, gin, a lemon, a pineapple, a pair of limes and an orange.

standard-dialogue-wizard-blizzard-task-d.npc: Hello, how did it go with the Wizard Blizzard.

standard-dialogue-wizard-blizzard-task-d.text: If the player has a premade wiz blz'd and no wizard blizzard in their inventory:

steps.npc: No, I need you to make the Wizard Blizzard yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.

standard-dialogue-wizard-blizzard-task-d.text: If the player no longer has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:
If the player has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:

steps.player: I haven't managed to make it yet.

steps.npc: Ok, it's one Wizard Blizzard I need.  Let me know when it's done.

standard-dialogue-wizard-blizzard-task-d.text: If the player has a wizard blizzard in their inventory:

steps.text: You give Blurberry the Wizard Blizzard. He takes a sip...

steps.npc: Well that is both Wizardy and Blizzardy. You're quite a bartender.
Okay, let's test you once more. Make me a SGG, then we'll see if you have what it takes.
A Short Green Guy, and don't bring me a gnome. Here's all you need.
I'm sure you'll make a great barman.

standard-dialogue-short-green-guy-dialog.npc: So, have you got my Short Green Guy?

standard-dialogue-short-green-guy-dialog.text: If the player has a premade sgg and no short green guy in their inventory:

steps.npc: No, I need you to make the SGG yourself. I'm afraid it doesn't really work if you try to sell the bar its own drinks.

standard-dialogue-short-green-guy-dialog.text: If the player no longer has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:
If the player has an empty cocktail shaker in their inventory:

steps.npc: I don't know what you have there but it's no Fruit Blast!

standard-dialogue-short-green-guy-dialog.text: If the player has a short green guy in their inventory:

steps.text: You give Blurberry the SGG. He takes a sip...

steps.npc: Ooh, that's a frisky little number. Very tart, how it should be. Excellent. Well I'm happy to recommend you to the Giannes. You truly are a gnomish bartender now..

steps.text: If the player has not completed Aluft Gianne Snr's training:

steps.npc: Well your training is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?

I think you're almost ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of a new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There are good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may
have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. Hel'll tell you what you need to do.

steps.text: If the player has completed Aluft Gianne Snr's training:

steps.npc: Aluft Gianne Snr. tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of the new Gnome Food Delivery service. I've heard there are
good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfill some of the other orders...
Go and have a chat with my young Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
